newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends up at intraday high vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends up at intraday high vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at an intraday high of 8.2900 on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.2920 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai after a sudden burst of speculative buying ahead of the close, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2909.
The yuan opened higher at an intraday low of 8.2910 and stuck to a narrow range around the opening price for most of the session before the leap just before closing time.
Trading was not active, dealers said.
Dealers said 8.2900 was the main psychological resistance level which buyers hoped to breach but which the central bank wanted to cap.
"Buyers wanted to breach the 8.2900 level, but today's rise has had little impact as the main tone of overall trading is one of stability," one dealer said.
Dealers said the market had established a pattern in recent days of sluggish trading almost to the close, followed by a flurry of movement.
